name: catalogue-week
title: Catalogue readiness meeting
subtitle: Fictional demo unless replaced with your own records

sections.title: Channel release status
sections.sql: SELECT sku,name,channel,missing_fields,claim_issues,reviewed,ready FROM release_queue ORDER BY sku,channel

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: SELECT sku,issue,detail,owner,due_on FROM attention ORDER BY due_on NULLS LAST

sections.title: Claim evidence
sections.sql: SELECT sku,statement,issue,review_due FROM claim_issues ORDER BY sku

sections.title: Open tasks
sections.sql: SELECT p.supplier,p.sku,t.title,t.owner,t.due_on FROM tasks t JOIN products p ON p.id=t.product_id WHERE t.status='open' ORDER BY p.supplier,t.due_on
